usage: - 壯 (zong3) is used to describe a plant that looks healthy, sturdy, and full of life. It is more natural for trees, stems, roots, and general growth than for flowers.
- It often collocates with plant-health words like 植物、樹、莖、根, and with verbs such as 長得 or 長得好 to talk about strong growth.
- In gardening talk, 壯 sounds positive and practical; it suggests the plant has good structure and can stand up well, not just that it is visually pretty.
- For learners, remember that 壯 is a short, descriptive word. It is commonly used in everyday speech and can work in both casual and general written Cantonese.
